notes.title: Tutorial Issue Summary
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your interest in this game!

Some players stuck in some parts of the game tutorial. This statement is used to sort out and answer all the questions collected. This statement will not be deleted and will be updated until there is no feedback on the game tutorial.

Please forgive me for not being able to reply to the email in time because of the time zone, as well as when I may be at work or other reasons.

If you do not get email reply  in time, you can find a solution from this statement below, which may solve your problem:

1. Some players are stuck in the following interface because they mistakenly thought that they should clicked the task prompt in the upper right corner to continue the game, but is is actually to click the row on the left(see the picture below). Pirate Valley’s location may change due to the randomness of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822628/d9f61e51da59d1865059383fced99bb0729a92c7.png[/img]

2. Some players unable to find pirate valley match for the first betting. The list on the left can actually be scrolled and operated with the left mouse button hold. I will optimize the scrolling operation later to make it more fit with the operating style of the PC. The UI design may be in order to be compatible with mobile devices, without considering some of the operating experience on the PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822628/a8a2c753613b779596a4c29316c1d25c73828458.png[/img]
